<!-- TDB page compatibility CSS v1.0.0 | legacy non-home components; preserves first paint | SHA 3c09843 -->
<link rel="stylesheet" data-tdb-page-compat href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/TheDentalBarns/tdb-webflow-runtime@3c0984362573aa1a0460dcc4fb86be61010890b4/dist/tdb-page-compat.css">
<style data-tdb-senses-standalone-v1>.tdb-senses-loading{box-sizing:border-box;position:fixed;inset:0;max-width:none;max-height:none;width:100%;height:100%;height:100dvh;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;overflow:hidden;background:#eeeae2;color:#252822;font-family:"Sweet Sans Pro x",Verdana,sans-serif}
.tdb-senses-loading::backdrop{background:#eeeae2}
.tdb-senses-loading-view{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:23px;text-align:center;padding:30px}
.tdb-senses-loading-ring{height:44px;width:44px;border:1px solid #c4c8bb;border-top-color:#48563c;border-radius:50%;animation:tdb-entry-turn 1.6s linear infinite}
.tdb-senses-loading-text{margin:0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.06em}
.tdb-senses-loading-close{position:absolute;top:max(22px,env(safe-area-inset-top));right:3vw;z-index:2;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:300 29px/1 Verdana,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.tdb-senses-loading-retry{border:1px solid #92978b;background:transparent;border-radius:40px;padding:12px 25px;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.tdb-senses-loading button:focus-visible{outline:1px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px}
.tdb-senses-preview{margin:0;background:#e6e3dc;display:grid;place-content:start center;min-height:100vh;padding:24px;gap:15px;font:12px/1.5 "Sweet Sans Pro x",Verdana,sans-serif;color:#333}
.tdb-senses-preview iframe{border:0;box-shadow:0 12px 50px #282a2122;background:#eeeae2}
.tdb-senses-preview p{margin:0}
@keyframes tdb-entry-turn{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

.tdb-senses-entry{margin:0;padding:0;display:block;width:100%;background:var(--base-color-brand--orange-1,#f9f2e6);color:#000;font:inherit}
.tdb-senses-entry-brand{filter:none}
.tdb-senses-entry [data-tdb-resource-intro] h1{margin:0 0 1.5rem}
.tdb-senses-entry-kicker{margin:0 0 1rem}
.tdb-senses-entry-description{max-width:48rem;margin:0 0 2rem;font-size:1.125rem;line-height:1.5}
.tdb-senses-entry-mobile-note{display:block;margin-top:.5rem;font-size:.8rem;color:#666}
.tdb-senses-entry [data-tdb-senses-open]{display:inline-flex;width:fit-content;max-width:100%;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1rem}
.tdb-senses-entry [data-tdb-senses-open] img{width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;object-fit:contain;filter:brightness(0)}
.tdb-senses-entry-note{font-size:.8rem;margin:1.5rem 0 0}
.tdb-senses-entry-footer{display:none}
.tdb-senses .tdb-senses-title{font-weight:300!important}
.tdb-senses,.tdb-senses-loading{outline:none!important}
.tdb-senses :focus-visible,.tdb-senses-loading :focus-visible,.tdb-senses-entry :focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--base-color-brand--orange-3,#d6cab4);outline-offset:4px}

</style>
<style data-calculator-availability>
#calculator-next-assessment{background:#222;color:var(--base-color-brand--orange-1,#f9f2e6)}
#calculator-next-assessment [data-availability-row]{width:100%;min-height:8rem;box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:2rem 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(214,202,180,.25);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font:inherit;text-align:center}
#calculator-next-assessment [data-availability-row]::before{content:"";width:3rem;flex:0 0 3rem}
#calculator-next-assessment [data-availability-row]>span{display:grid;flex:1;min-width:0;gap:4px}
#calculator-next-assessment [data-availability-row]>span>span:first-child{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;line-height:18px;opacity:.7}
#calculator-next-assessment [aria-live]{position:relative;justify-self:center;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;font-weight:400;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
#calculator-next-assessment [aria-live]::before,#calculator-next-assessment [aria-live]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-16px;top:7px;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#888;pointer-events:none}
#calculator-next-assessment [aria-live]::after{opacity:0}
#calculator-next-assessment [data-live="true"]::before,#calculator-next-assessment [data-live="true"]::after{background:var(--base-color-brand--orange-3,#d6cab4)}
#calculator-next-assessment [data-live="true"]::after{animation:calculator-live-pulse 2.8s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes calculator-live-pulse{0%{transform:scale(1);opacity:0}12%{opacity:.7}70%,100%{transform:scale(2.4);opacity:0}}
#calculator-next-assessment button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:3rem;height:3rem;flex:0 0 3rem;padding:0;background:transparent;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:50%;color:var(--base-color-brand--orange-3,#d6cab4);cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;transition:background-color 300ms ease}
#calculator-next-assessment button:disabled{cursor:wait}
#calculator-next-assessment button:active{background:rgba(214,202,180,.15)}
#calculator-next-assessment button[aria-busy="true"]{background-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--base-color-brand--orange-1,#f9f2e6) 30%,transparent)}
#calculator-next-assessment svg{display:block;flex-shrink:0;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}

/* Match the calculator’s quiet loading pulse. */
#calculator-next-assessment [data-availability-row]:has(button[aria-busy="true"]) [aria-live]{animation:tdb-availability-loading-text 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes tdb-availability-loading-text{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.45}}

</style>
<style data-tdb-resource-intro-v1>/* Standalone page introductions v1.0.0 — identical on Gallery, Calculator and Five Senses. */
.tdb-sg-intro,.tdb-senses-entry-brand{box-sizing:border-box;min-height:70lvh;background:#222;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:5rem 3vw;width:100%;margin:0}
.tdb-sg-intro>.container-large{width:100%}
.tdb-sg-intro .usp-logo_top-wrapper,.tdb-senses-entry-brand [data-senses-brand-grid]{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 1px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:3rem;width:100%}
.tdb-sg-intro .tdb-sg-intro-logo,.tdb-senses-entry-brand img{width:10rem;height:10rem;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:contain;justify-self:end;max-width:100%;flex-shrink:0}
.tdb-sg-intro .vertical-line,.tdb-senses-entry-brand [data-senses-brand-line]{width:1px;height:6rem;justify-self:center;background:var(--base-color-brand--orange-3,#d6cab4)}
.tdb-sg-intro .tdb-sg-intro-title,.tdb-senses-entry-brand [data-senses-brand-title]{justify-self:start;min-width:0;max-width:100%;text-align:left;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.5;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--base-color-brand--orange-3,#d6cab4);margin:0}
[data-tdb-resource-intro]{background:var(--base-color-brand--orange-2,#ebe2d2);color:var(--base-color-brand--black,#000)}
[data-tdb-resource-intro] [data-tdb-resource-kicker]{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:400;opacity:.5}
@keyframes tdb-resource-dd{0%{opacity:0}50%,75%{opacity:.5}100%{opacity:.1}}
@supports(animation-timeline:view()){@mediaall{[data-tdb-resource-intro] [data-tdb-resource-kicker]{animation:tdb-resource-dd linear both;animation-timeline:view();animation-range:entry 0% exit 0%}}}
@media(max-width:767px){.tdb-sg-intro,.tdb-senses-entry-brand{min-height:60lvh;padding:4rem 5vw}.tdb-sg-intro .usp-logo_top-wrapper,.tdb-senses-entry-brand [data-senses-brand-grid]{gap:1.5rem}}

/* Shared breathing room for the introduction and its light content section. */
[data-tdb-resource-intro] .padding-section-small,[data-tdb-resource-tool],#treatment-calculator .tdbc-shell,[data-tdb-sg-gallery-spacing]{padding-top:7rem;padding-bottom:7rem}
[data-tdb-resource-intro] .padding-section-small > p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
@media(max-width:991px){[data-tdb-resource-intro] .padding-section-small,[data-tdb-resource-tool],#treatment-calculator .tdbc-shell,[data-tdb-sg-gallery-spacing]{padding-top:6rem;padding-bottom:6rem}}
@media(max-width:767px){[data-tdb-resource-intro] .padding-section-small,[data-tdb-resource-tool],#treatment-calculator .tdbc-shell,[data-tdb-sg-gallery-spacing]{padding-top:6rem;padding-bottom:6rem}}
</style>

<script data-tdb-instagram-staging>
/* TDB Instagram bootstrap v0.6.4. Pin 2fad009b6d71d82938b09240cd47704a81fbb044 after committing. */
(() => {
  if (!['dentalbarns.webflow.io','thedentalbarns.com','www.thedentalbarns.com','thedentalbarns.co.uk','www.thedentalbarns.co.uk'].includes(location.hostname)) return;
  const widgets = ['d03f7f34-0953-4575-946c-bca5b6a21bed','9abfdbc1-5cc2-4de0-bf56-1093d967c2be','35374f05-af95-4b8c-9480-e091c19319c8','3cbfb5f1-fbeb-4c0c-b53c-6a91daa4aa04'];
  const mounts = [];
  widgets.forEach(id => document.querySelectorAll('.elfsight-app-' + id).forEach(node => {
    node.classList.remove('elfsight-app-' + id);
    node.removeAttribute('data-elfsight-app-lazy');
    node.dataset.tdbIgWidget = id;
    node.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    const status = document.createElement('span');
    status.className = 'tdb-ig-loading';
    status.textContent = 'From our Instagram';
    node.replaceChildren(status);
    mounts.push(node);
  }));
  if (!mounts.length) return;
  const script = document.createElement('script');
  script.src = document.documentElement.dataset.wfPage === '677cf86df9952f978d94d8a9' && matchMedia('(min-width:992px)').matches
    ? 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/TheDentalBarns/tdb-webflow-runtime@37ca9147f41e4ab45af4e3619147f1de4048f2e6/dist/tdb-home-desktop-instagram.js'
    : 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/TheDentalBarns/tdb-webflow-runtime@37ca9147f41e4ab45af4e3619147f1de4048f2e6/dist/tdb-instagram-feed.js';
  script.dataset.tdbInstagramJs = '0.6.4';
  script.onerror = () => mounts.forEach(node => {
    node.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = 'https://www.instagram.com/thedentalbarns/';
    link.target = '_blank';
    link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    link.textContent = 'View our Instagram';
    node.replaceChildren(link);
  });
  document.head.append(script);
})();
</script>
<script defer data-calculator-availability src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/TheDentalBarns/tdb-webflow-runtime@0ca09e55c6fc3325ad3a964b17b88832c84eed56/dist/tdb-availability-header.js"></script>
<!-- TDB Five Senses Surgery staging v0.24.3 -->
<!-- Five Senses controller loads on activation through the consent-released runtime. -->
<script data-tdb-senses-branding>(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('[data-tdb-senses-open]');if(b){const arrow=b.querySelector('[aria-hidden]');if(arrow)arrow.remove();const i=document.createElement('img');i.src="https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/677cf86cf9952f978d94d80c/678aba6948c1f2433e11fcd0_Logo%20Icon%20-%2024%2048_Core%20Value%20Lotus%20Print%20192.svg";i.alt='';i.className='icon-embed-xxsmall';b.append(i);}const p=document.querySelector('.tdb-senses-entry-description');if(p){p.textContent='Discover the details that make the difference.';const note=document.createElement('span');note.className='tdb-senses-entry-mobile-note';note.textContent='Designed for mobile';p.append(note);}})();</script>
